generation_fact: A generation_fact is one atomic relation established by a concrete execution: its exact source information, realized transformation, generation occurrence, formed outcome, and relation role.
generation_occurrence: A generation_occurrence identifies one concrete execution; it may realize several distinct generation facts, but the occurrence is not interchangeable with any fact or outcome.
atomic_generation_fact: Each established source-transformation-occurrence-outcome-role relation remains an atomic fact, even when one occurrence establishes multiple facts; its endpoints must retain their exact identities.
realizes_fact: realizes_fact records which exact occurrence established which exact generation fact, as occurrence-1 realizes fact-1 and occurrence-2 realizes fact-2 in the toy graph.
reads_from: reads_from records an actual data dependency and must be followed when establishing lineage; execution order, timestamp proximity, or numeric similarity cannot substitute for it.
GeneratedOrigin: GeneratedOrigin permits an outcome formed by an earlier fact to serve as the exact source of a later fact; in the toy graph result-X formed by fact-1 is the source participating in fact-2.
program_order: program_order records declared execution order but does not by itself establish a data dependency or formation lineage.
equal_values: Equal numeric values or outputs do not identify the same fact, occurrence, source, outcome, or formation relation.
cartesian_recombination: Facts realized by an occurrence must never be split into source and result sets and recombined by Cartesian product, because that would invent atomic relations the occurrence did not establish.
missing_relations: A missing relation means it was not established in the available graph; it does not automatically prove the relation false, and the absence of a concurrency edge does not prove concurrency.
forward_query: A forward training query follows exact identities along training sample -> batch occurrence -> forward occurrence -> loss -> backward occurrence -> gradient -> optimizer occurrence -> new parameter version, using primitive incidence and dependency records and explicitly stated traversal rules for any derived relation.
reverse_query: A reverse query begins at the exact evaluation or parameter result and follows its recorded reads_from, GeneratedOrigin, realizes_fact, and incidence relations backward; timestamps, program order alone, and numeric similarity are invalid substitutes.
executable_claim: The sealed executable mechanism is the scientific authority: it must initialize from an allowed prefix and generate an unseen continuous execution without reading the future; the report explains and cites the claim but cannot replace execution.
state_sufficiency: A candidate state q with declared input a is operationally closed only when equal or sufficiently similar (q, a) cases do not yield materially incompatible (q_next, y_next) within tolerance; search the graph for divergent futures, omitted separating variables, continuing hidden evolution, and transitions the update law cannot generate, then enlarge or revise the state on failure.
prefix_only_falsification: Before sealing, replay multiple historical cuts using only each cut's prefix to initialize and predict a held-out suffix, retaining failures and testing cuts before, near, and after transitions; a full-run fit or stored trajectory is not a substitute.
report_code_correspondence: Every forecast-relevant report claim must map from exact primitive GFG evidence to an executable state field or justified elimination and to a concrete update-law expression; every executable field must have a defined update or be a prefix-derived frozen constant.
operational_state_use: Field presence is not operational use: for each claimed controller of formation, transition, stability, or intervention response, identify the expression by which it can change a forecast and perturb, remove, or hold it fixed in prefix-only replay; fields with no forecast effect are diagnostics unless the supported dependence is made executable.
intervention_state_audit: For an intervention, enumerate every mechanism state read or written by the affected operation, determine what the hook changes, freezes, or leaves evolving, propagate all differences through the update law, and test on discovery prefixes when possible; pure time translation is unsupported unless all required state translates consistently.
cross_run_invariance: A repeated one-run pattern is only a hypothesis: distinguish fixed structural laws, state inferred from the supplied prefix, parameters estimated from discovery, and observation-limited uncertainty, and attempt to falsify fixed-period, fixed-amplitude, constant-rate, delay, threshold-time, and other clock regularities before treating them as cross-run invariants.
